instruction: Open the Chrome bookmarks manager for me.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome's bookmarks manager page (chrome://bookmarks/). This maintains the same difficulty level as the original task - a simple navigation to a Chrome internal page. The evaluator uses existing functions: is_expected_active_tab_approximate metric and active_url_from_accessTree getter to verify the active tab URL matches chrome://bookmarks/.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts active tab URL using get_active_url_from_accessTree getter from accessibility tree
Metric is_expected_active_tab_approximate appropriately compares URLs ignoring query parameters, suitable for Chrome internal pages
Expected URL 'chrome://bookmarks/' is semantically correct for Chrome's bookmarks manager interface
Complete instruction coverage - evaluator verifies navigation to bookmarks manager as requested
Data flow is correct: getter returns URL string -> metric receives and compares -> expected value matches requirement
Getter config correctly uses empty goto_prefix for chrome:// internal URLs (not https://)
No postconfig needed as bookmarks page remains accessible after navigation for verification
Edge cases handled: metric accepts both string URLs and dict format with 'url' field
